name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2026-04-12, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
